title: Prime Minister condoles the loss of lives due to a mishap in Tarn Taran, Punjab
body_text: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi has expressed deep sadness over the loss of lives due to a mishap in Tarn Taran, Punjab. Extending his heartfelt condolences to those who have lost their loved ones in this tragic mishap, the Prime Minister prayed that the injured recover at the earliest. The Prime Minister's Office posted on X: "Saddened to hear about the loss of lives due to a mishap in Tarn Taran, Punjab. My condolences to those who have lost their loved ones in this tragic mishap. May the injured recover at the earliest: PM @narendramodi" Saddened to hear about the loss of lives due to a mishap in Tarn Taran, Punjab.
